summary: This clinical trial is testing a study drug called DWP16001 for adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus. The trial aims to enroll 134 participants who will take the study drug once a day for 52 weeks. Daewoong Pharmaceutical Co. LTD. is sponsoring this Phase 3 study, which currently has a status of Unknown status. Researchers will measure safety and how well the treatment works by tracking blood sugar and other health tests over time.
